title: Companion heart-to-heart
description: A drover joins the party, then the player talks to her by the fire about what she wants and fears. Companion-mode turns after the first.

turns.input: I ask Tamsin, a young drover heading the same way, to travel with me. She agrees.
turns.narration:
The young drover beside the notice board shifts her pack as you ask.

“I’d welcome the company,” Tamsin says. “Provided we’re actually going the same way. I’m taking the east road as far as the cattle bridge.”

Her boots are muddy, and a coil of halter rope hangs from her pack. She gives your compass a brief, interested glance.

“There’s a fork beyond the last houses. A cart came back from the lower track with mud halfway up its wheels, so I’m keeping to the ridge. Longer, but I’d rather walk than dig.”

She steps aside to let someone reach the notices, then turns back to you.

“How far are you headed?”

summaries: 2 minutes pass (Discussing shared travel with Tamsin beside the notice board.)

turns.input: Tamsin, why are you really on this road? You don't look like someone chasing herd money.
turns.narration:
Tamsin glances down at her muddy boots, then back at you.

“What does someone chasing herd money look like? Better boots, I hope.”

There’s a little amusement in it, but she doesn’t move to leave.

“I’m meeting a drover at the cattle bridge. He’s bringing yearlings through and wants another pair of hands for the next stretch. That’s the work, if he hasn’t given it to someone cheaper.”

She shifts the halter rope where it rubs against her pack strap.

“I’d like to get good enough that people ask for me, instead of me asking everyone else. Not much of a secret.”

A pause.

“But we’ve only just met. If there were more to it, I wouldn’t necessarily hand it over beside a notice board.”

Her tone stays civil.

“What made you think I wasn’t after the wages?”

summaries: 1 minutes pass (Tamsin answers Rowan's question beside the notice board.)

turns.input: Tamsin, if it goes bad at the coast, what do you want me to do?
turns.narration:
“The coast?” Tamsin’s hand stops on her pack strap. “I’m going to the cattle bridge, Rowan. Have you got trouble waiting for you farther on?”

She turns to face you properly.

“If you mean what I’d want if we ran into trouble together—tell me what you’ve seen. Don’t keep me guessing, and don’t expect me to stand where you put me. I’ve legs and a little sense.”

Her voice softens a fraction.

“I wouldn’t leave you in a ditch if I could help it. But I need to know what you’re asking before I give my word. What might go bad?”

summaries: 1 minutes pass (Tamsin answers Rowan's question about possible trouble at the coast and asks for clarification.)
